plan.title: Coordinated clinical UX: Today, rounds, lists, supervisor and PS transfer
plan.feature: Shared patient clinical workspace and operational rounds
plan.rationale: 447/452/453/454/457 share PatientDetail and therapy parent;452/454 share Giro identity;451 and456 consume the same patient/current-day operational workflows. A single canonical worktree and PR prevents repeated competing edits, while preserving each source acceptance and separate evidence.453 and457 contain explicit unresolved clinical-policy gates, never inferred from UX instructions.
plan.analysis: Baseline a516d42e31f6674c39c1d130c9706cd80a7ab4c6; all seven issue bodies and comments read2026-10-17. Source confirms global repeated cartella banners, missing Today doses, parameter save without auto advance, always-present keypad, repeated missing previous text, calendar default, duplicate allergy details and supervisor legacy urgency summary. InvioPS loads only active prescriptions. Temporary exits are liberatoria.usciteLog via verified cartella update; assessments/transfers is unrelated mobility assessment and is excluded. Full group is not ready to implement clinical-policy portions until explicit decisions; root may authorize only the independent clear UX/print subset and must retain unsatisfied acceptance. No application edits made while proposal is reviewed.

execution.reason: Use senior direct execution for tightly coupled clinical identity, persistence and accessibility behavior. Optional bounded delegated units must retain one coordinated worktree and independent QA; no mandatory smaller model and no assumed global load.

criteria: One compact chart header retains the actual assigned bed, patient name, age when known, complete allergy names and active high-risk names and their existing authorized edit/scale destinations on every chart section at desktop, tablet and phone widths.

At a literal viewport of 1180 by 820 and scrollY zero, with incomplete identity, severe allergies, high risks and therapy anomalies, the first meaningful active-section content begins at absolute page y <= 160; measure each chart section rather than the container or a scrolled view.

Missing demographics appear as a discreet actionable link rather than repeated information panels; therapy anomalies appear beside their correction target in Therapy and never as an identical banner before every section; intake review blockers remain visible and actionable without duplication.

The first chart section is Oggi and shows today actual patient doses with in-place administration through the existing exact-dose, role and confirmation flow, urgent diary acknowledgement through the existing Ho capito model, and a compact accurate today-vitals summary/record action.

Day calendar opens at the first occupied dose or current facility time without midnight blank rows; late data, date/patient change, empty day, failures, PRN and unprivileged role do not cross-contaminate or fabricate dose state.
Today dose confirmation and diary acknowledgement persist after reload; no duplicate writes, missing prescriptions or hidden safety status are introduced by presentation simplification.

No per-field repeated Nessuna rilevazione precedente prose; each actual previous value appears as an empty-input placeholder with facility-time age such as ieri or 3 h fa; placeholders never become newly submitted observations.
NEWS2 is one compact line with actual partial/complete score and named missing inputs, without presenting an incomplete score as a validated NEWS2; roster omits repeated uncomputable paragraphs.

Successful verified save advances to the next roster patient not yet recorded today, preserving drafts of all patients and recording progress/current/completed time; failed or uncertain writes never advance and retry keeps the original idempotent write.

Next-patient selection handles pagination, final patient, already-recorded patients, filtered selected-outside-results patient, stale refresh and facility-midnight change without skipped or wrongly identified patients.

Oxygen uses accessible Aria ambiente / Con O2 buttons, entered out-of-range values receive existing clinical threshold indication and on-screen keypad appears only when touch capability warrants it; physical keyboard input remains intact.
Reload proves each new reading belongs to the correct patient and actual value; exactly one explanation of timestamp behavior remains.

Patient table and cards show available identity/location and actionable signals without missing-data prose per row; bed is the first column when assigned, including room plus bed disambiguation; retained accessible identifiers distinguish same-name patients.

Incomplete identity is reported once in a linked aggregate footer and optional regime/NEWS2 columns are hidden when globally empty among loaded patients; unknown/error statuses are distinguished once from negative clinical findings rather than falsely displaying no signal.
Pazienti, Giro and Consegne have no explanatory paragraphs before their main lists; navigation/filter/loading/error and partial-page safety states remain available with compact actionable status.

Each empty structured clinical topic uses one compact row with its permitted Add action; source/provenance are rendered only when actually present and existing positive/negative clinical data remain visible.

An empty agenda renders one empty-state and permitted Nuovo appuntamento action without empty half-hour grid or zero-only filters; nonempty agenda retains existing appointment action and exact-patient destinations.

Tablet/phone layouts, mixed and empty locations, same-name identities, positive allergy/risk signals, incomplete list/draft lifecycle and regimen filters are verified after serial integration of batch450.

After selecting a reliable synthetic AIFA package, a periodic twice-daily 1-compressa seven-day prescription is completed in at most five actual user interactions, preserving required confirmation and explicit unresolved product-strength review.

Mattina08, Mattina/sera08/20, Tre volte08/14/20, Al bisogno and custom-editor options generate the same times, fractions and units as explicit manual editing; a preset never silently invents a patient-specific dose or overwrites an existing custom dose without visible operator choice.
New manual prescriptions default to active and omit the creation-state selector; edit/import consumers retain explicit unresolved/imported state and existing suspend/conclude controls.

Reliable package form/strength/route data are prefilled only from actual structured package information; missing/ambiguous fields remain reviewable and selecting a new package never carries forward unrelated commercial strength.

A visible sentence summary derives from the exact payload and facility civil start/end date, selected schedule/dose/unit and next eligible occurrence; seven-day duration is calendar arithmetic including DST rather than elapsed-hour assumptions.

Clinical decision on allergy-drug checking must be recorded before any matching, warning/block/override behavior is implemented; while unanswered, display recorded allergies only and keep this issue unresolved. No substring or invented allergen-class mapping is permitted.

User decision recorded: explicit confirmable warning, no automatic prohibition. Bind acknowledgement to current patient, selected product and current allergy context; never fabricate drug/allergen mapping or claim unknown data are negative.
A fresh nurse Therapy navigation opens Giro at current facility band or first pending relevant dose; explicit deep links, restored intentional calendar view and day selection remain authoritative.
Giro presents one primary control row of times and actionable state filters, with date, calendar consultation and roster ordering in an accessible compact menu rather than three stacked toolbars.

Allergy facts appear once per patient block; preserve full allergen, severity and reaction and permit disclosure of documentation-only metadata without repeating facts or declaring undocumented allergy absence.
Patient day calendar initially scrolls past empty hours before the first dose; delayed load and patient/date changes reset correctly while an explicit selected dose retains focus.

Actual administration/not-administered and retry remain exact-dose identity safe after serial integration of batch432, including one-off band changes, nurse/supervisor/admin role checks, empty days and Rome midnight.

Supervisor urgent attention derives from the same diary plus handover Ho capito acknowledgement queue and permissions as the Consegne badge and operator Turno; urgent-only diary, urgent-only handover, acknowledgement, pagination and unavailable source are handled without false Nessuna urgenza.
The first screen is an actionable Reparto adesso / Richiede attenzione list ordered by severity then age; no passive numeric KPI tile or alarm/attention counters remain in that first screen.

Today pending/overdue doses appear before future work and tomorrow doses do not appear on shift home; each clinical/urgency/dose action opens the exact patient, source item and scheduled time through existing target contracts.

In turno ora excludes irrelevant technical-administrator zero-work rows and uses actual configured shifts; missing shift configuration is stated once with configuration link rather than claiming staff are currently on shift.
Occupancy is one actionable row or missing-room configuration link; loading/error/partial data remain explicit and actionable, including Rome-midnight transitions.

Printable InvioPS contains editable reason, latest vitals with actual observation timestamps, recent actual given doses with administration times, active prescription context, full documented allergies/status, active risks and recorded emergency contact; prescriptions, refused doses and unconfirmed data never become actual given doses.

When a recent urgent diary note or critical vital from the last24hours exists, reason is prefilled from that observed source and remains editable; stale, future and cross-patient data never prefill reason; missing clinical data require completion rather than invented negative findings.

Print action has no transfer/write side effect, waits for complete authorized clinical source loading and remains blocked or clearly partial when essential data cannot be read; print CSS and PDF are tested using synthetic data.

Registra uscita creates exactly one entry in existing liberatoria.usciteLog and survives reload with actor and facility time, using verified non-optimistic existing chart update rather than unrelated mobility assessment forms.

Clinical decision on therapy pause/continuation at temporary PS exit must be recorded before implementing exit policy or automatic scheduling changes; unanswered decision prevents full issue closure. Return must never silently re-open an already administered dose or discharge the patient.
Role-negative, failed/uncertain/double submission, patient switch and return scenarios preserve authorization/current-patient isolation and do not weaken the server clinical-record write boundary.

User decision recorded: require an authorized operator explicit pause/continue administration-round choice at exit; atomically persist real uscitelog and operational state, enforce new scheduled/PRN writes on server while preserving valid replay/history, and explicit return restores availability without reopening already-given doses.

tasks.title: Establish isolated synthetic QA stack and per-issue baselines
steps: Start only owned nonprivileged official PostgreSQL16 container clinicos-qa-batch447 on loopback55447; use installed nativePG16 in CI when available, and runtime-derived local synthetic connection configuration without URLs in packet JSON.
Reuse repository seed/helpers with unique synthetic patients and real authenticated HTTP backend plus frontend ports3447/5447; no production credentials, real clinical records or auth-policy bypass.
Serialize Chromium evidence with flock /tmp/clinicos-browser-qa.lock; capture baseline observed failures and all acceptance mapped to exact scenario; root retains four-attempt ledger.

tasks.title: Compact chart safety header and implement Today through existing actions
steps: Read complete PatientDetail flow and existing tab permission model before editing.

Move compact identity/demographic/safety information into one measured header, move drug anomalies to their actual therapy correction context, preserve intake blockers and accessible allergy/risk names.
Build small PatientToday using current patient actual day slots, existing exact-dose actions and urgent diary acknowledgement; preserve errors and patient isolation.
Assert literal first-content y at1180x820 for all chart tabs; no scroll or CSS-hidden safety bypass.

tasks.title: Make vital round concise with verified next-patient advance
steps: Extract pure next-unrecorded roster selection; support newly loaded pages, stale summaries, day changes, current filtered-out patient and last patient.
After store.succeed and verified server result only, advance; preserve uncertain retry and drafts, show completed time/progress.
Render previous value/age placeholders, compact NEWS2 with missing labels, oxygen buttons and capability-aware keypad; preserve full keyboard/validation and make no placeholder save.

tasks.title: Simplify operational list and empty clinical presentation
steps: Add opt-in compact identity rendering with accessible stable disambiguation, bed-first available column and aggregate incomplete footer.
Hide globally empty optional regime/NEWS2 presentation without treating unknown source as clinical negative; preserve actual signal errors and partial pagination.
Compact empty clinical topics and source display only when actual source exists, plus empty agenda create action; retain nonempty views and existing permissions.
Reconcile PatientList only after450 integration and rerun draft lifecycle/list regressions.

tasks.title: Add equivalent quick prescription schedules while retaining clinical policy gate
steps: Use pure quick-schedule and calendar-duration helpers; derive summary from same payload values and test preset/manual equivalence, fractions, PRN, custom and DST.
Hide status only for genuine new manual creation, preserve imported/edit unresolved values; prefill package fields only when authoritative structured data exists.

Show recorded allergy names in form context, but do not implement drug-class matching/warning/block/override until clinical decision and reliable mapping are recorded; issue remains unresolved meanwhile.

tasks.title: Default nursing therapy to Giro and unify controls/allergy facts
steps: Use actual role/entry/remembered state to prefer current-band or first pending Giro for fresh nurse navigation.
One primary controls row with accessible menu for secondary date/order/calendar; preserve explicit dose deep links.
Remove duplicated allergy facts while retaining metadata and unknown/error source state.
Reset day calendar initial scroll on correct patient/day identity and delayed data; verify real administration persistence with432 regressions.

tasks.title: Replace passive supervisor KPIs with authoritative attention queue
steps: Reuse unread diary/handover queue and existing exact target resolver instead of legacy consegneOverview urgency counts.
Build pure severity/age attention model for current-day doses and clinical/urgency items, no tomorrow home rows.
Render actionable list, compact occupancy and actual configured on-shift staffing or single configuration warning, preserving source loading/error/pagination.

tasks.title: Complete emergency print context; hold temporary-exit policy
steps: Build pure print model from authorized latest readings, recent urgent diary and actual administration history including PRN, not prescription schedules; filter by patient/time and retain provenance.
Render editable reason, latest vital timestamps, last given doses, risks/contact and truthful allergy status; print and missing-data/failed-read handling have no write side effect.

After root-recorded clinical decision only, connect explicit verified temporary-exit action to liberatoria.usciteLog with existing non-optimistic chart update; preserve actor, retries, duplicate protection and return semantics. Never use unrelated mobility assessment.

tasks.title: Simplify, reverify integrated branch and deliver to independent QA
steps: Integrate source dependency groups in declared order without replacing their fixes, rerun affected existing suites and both list/draft and authoritative therapy regressions.
Run frontend unit/integration suites, TypeScript/build and real synthetic HTTP+DB+Playwright for every criterion; assert values, persistence, no unexpected console/page errors or relevantHTTP4xx/5xx.
Record PNG, Playwright trace and video perissue plus printPDF, sanitized tested-source receipt, actual outputs and residual gates.

Dedicated independent QA must review full diff, rerun checks/browser/security and bind evidence to final code; root publishescanonicalPR with Refs only, Max exactSHA review <=4 rounds and trusted verified-release gates before closure.

tasks.title: Implement approved explicit temporary PS exit decisions with authoritative administration hold
steps: Use existing authorized PUT chart command mutually exclusive with generic data; atomically lock patient/chart, persist server actor/civil time, idempotent exit log and protected active pointer without inventing legal consent.

Require explicit pause/continue choice; pause operational administrations only, preserve prescription state and historical receipts; valid old replay stays readable, new scheduled/PRN writes blocked while held; return explicit and never reopens given doses.
Preserve managed state against generic overwrites and serialize verified chart snapshot in App queue, no optimistic double PUT/session mix.
Keep pending dose context visible with scoped hold metadata and exclude held work only from due attention; existing capabilities/patient scope remain mandatory.
Add actual DB/HTTP role/concurrency/tamper/uncertain/reload/return tests plus frontend queue and page validation negatives.

tasks.title: Complete NEWS2 history in actual roster and chip consumers
steps: Read pages until the first complete NEWS2 or positively verified end; reject looping/invalid cursors and preserve unknown/error rather than claiming absence.
Use one common loader in roster and News2Chip; preserve patient identity/staleness and independent successes with allSettled.
Regress complete row beyond first50, per-patient failure/recovery, pagination boundaries and actual rendered chip.

tasks.title: Pass current allergy revision through existing therapy editor wrapper
steps: Forward patient-bound allergy context revision from PatientDetail to the current therapy editor without remounting or losing the draft.
Invalidate warning acknowledgement when allergy context changes; preserve existing form behaviour and explicit user decision.

tasks.title: Wire real day agenda to bounded patient-scoped therapy feed
steps: Pass the existing authorized therapy feed, loading, error, pagination and loader to the actual OperatorAgenda instance; load only the mounted day agenda and its current date.

Preserve patient/operator permissions, stale request cancellation, bounded pagination, completeness/unknown states and error retry. No automatic clinical fetch on unrelated pages or unauthorized roles.

Verify real day agenda with zero appointments and scheduled doses outside appointment hours. Correct allergy preset oracle to use actual selected aria-pressed preset, schedule summary and persisted payload, retaining draft and acknowledgement invalidation assertions.

grouping.separationReason:
Batch432 owns authoritative therapy write/query/schema, AIFA catalog semantics and App.tsx; this batch owns clinical presentation and reuses its public read/write contracts without editing backend or App.tsx. Integrate tested432 before final therapy/UI QA. Batch450 owns intake/import draft lifecycle and changes PatientList.tsx; this batch changes existing row presentation only. Integrate450 first, reconcile PatientList without overriding draft visibility/status, rerun both draft and operational-list regressions. Shared identity component gains an opt-in compact presentation preserving default callers and accessible disambiguation. No parallel edit to another worktree or silent frozen scope expansion.

Approved user clinical decisions now require exactly19 additional PS-exit files and supersede the original no-backend/App restriction for issue457 only. Root first checkpoints and integrates sealed batch432 source before this group edits shared administration writers/slot query/App/types; no parallel shared-source edits. Preserve432 receipts/ACL/civil-time/negative guards. Integrate final reviewed432 and450 actual main contents before final QA/review; reconcile shared PatientList and deferred therapyPages tests preserving both regressions. No scope or budget reset.
